pricing.title: Transparante boekhoudprijzen
pricing.lead: We keep your books, priced on what you spend each month. All packages include A4 portal access.
pricing.p1Desc: You send us the paperwork and we keep the books: documents coded, bank reconciled, and figures you can rely on each month.
pricing.p1f1: We code and post every document
pricing.p1f3: A qualified accountant on the file
pricing.p2Desc: Everything in Self-employed, kept to the standard a Malta company's statutory filings need — ready for the VAT return, the annual accounts and the tax return.
pricing.p3Desc: Full-service toezicht van een A4-partner: managementrapportage, forecasting en maandelijkse adviesgesprekken.
pricing.foot: All fees exclude VAT and include A4 portal access. Self-employed and Company are priced on your monthly expenses across nine bands, with unlimited documents and no software-only plan. Partner oversight is quoted after a short call. Government and registry fees are passed through at cost. If we keep your books we cannot also be your auditor; independence rules do not allow the same firm to do both.
